title: move_data_references input
description: Moves the open mappings and data uses of one domain to another, for a split, a merge or before a domain is retired. When both domains answer to the same data owner, each row keeps its identity, so its decisions stay with it and its state is computed again: a use whose new domain is stricter shows re-decide. When the data owner changes, the decisions do not move: a decided row is ended and declared again in the new domain, a waiting decision is asked again of the new data owner, one someone already answered is withdrawn, and the engine opens and sends a new decision for each row that needs one. Owners move only through propose_owner_change. An AI client may preview the move with validateOnly, and its preview runs every rule the person's move runs; a person makes it.
